purpose: Teach: ヒール/ハザード/聖職/刺繍/中心地/辿っ/オートバイ/マンゴー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ハイヒール、絶対、新作、買ったわよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、見てね
lines.en: Aoi, I just bought the most gorgeous new heels—seriously, you have to see them.
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. Warm excitement in the voice. Leans forward with genuine enthusiasm. A slight breathless rush on 'gorgeous new heels.' Natural, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。彼の車、本気で、絶対、ハザードランプ、絶対、点けてた時、メイちゃん、葵、絶対、感謝したよ
lines.en: Yeah? He actually turned on the hazard lights for me—I was so grateful.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. A slight smile in the voice, not loud. Quiet gratitude held in the words. Slower pace, lingering on the memory. Almost to herself at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、聖職者、絶対、お友達、いるんだって、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: My grandfather has a friend who's a priest, you know. I think that's really admirable.
lines.style: Curious, gentle wondering aloud. Thoughtful pause before the last sentence. Genuine interest without pushing. Warm, open delivery. Slight trailing-off that invites response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、刺繍の入った、絶対、ブラウス、お洒落でしょ?メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、お客様にも、本気で、絶対、好評、絶対、感謝、本気。
lines.en: Look at this embroidered blouse—don't you think it's stylish? My customers have been saying such nice things about it.
lines.style: Warm, a touch proud. Light, conversational rhythm. Slight lift on 'don't you think.' Genuine pleasure in sharing, not seeking validation so much as inviting her in. Open and present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お台場、本気で、絶対、東京の中心地に、絶対、近いよね、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、彼と、絶対、デート、行きたいわよね、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Odaiba's pretty close to central Tokyo, isn't it? I'd really love to go on a date there with him sometime.
lines.style: Eager, playful daydream quality. Slight breathiness on 'close to central Tokyo.' Pace quickens slightly mid-sentence. Soft, hopeful trailing-off at the end, like imagining it aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お父さんの足跡、本気で、絶対、辿った旅、絶対、メイちゃん、本気で、感動したのよ、葵
lines.en: Following my father's footsteps on that trip really moved me, Aoi.
lines.style: Wistful, quiet reverence. Slower pace. Weight on 'really moved me'—not performative, genuinely felt. Gentle exhale at the end. Distant but warm, like holding a memory close.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼、本気で、絶対、オートバイ、新しいの、絶対、買ったって、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、楽しみよね
lines.en: He got a new motorcycle, apparently—I'm really excited to see it.
lines.style: Eager, anticipatory. Slight lift on 'apparently'—casual but interested. Quick, light rhythm. Genuine pleasure in the news. Warm, conversational tone without artifice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏のメニューに、本気で、絶対、マンゴー、絶対、加えたわよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、味わってみて
lines.en: I added mango to the summer menu—you should definitely come in and try it.
lines.style: Warm, close, inviting. Gentle pride in the decision. Opens with quiet confidence, softens into welcome on the invitation. Natural, present tone. Like sharing something small and genuine.
